title.narrative: MHPSS Surge Mechanism workstream via UNICEF, including IFRC/MHPSS Hub and IOM. Forms part of overall activity registered under 230002651.

description.narrative:
This bemo is a shadow text to bemo 230002651 for the MHPSS Surge Mechanism. A second bemo is needed because we need to administer different workstreams of the activity on several budgetplaces - i.e. "opdrachten"; "bijdragen aan agentschappen", and "bijdragen aan internationale organisaties". One IMPACT-bemo cannot (yet) cater for two budgetplaces.
The MHPSS Surge mechanism is managed by RVO, but part of the contribution is channeled straightaway by NL MFA to UNICEF and through UNICEF to IOM and IFRC/MHPSS/Hub.
The two above aspects are explained in MINBUZA-2025.2650183.
The current activity in Impact refers in several places to the overall bemo, or is copied from that. Specific elements are included in this particular IMPACT file for "finances" and "reporting".
Behind the abovementioned top-up, a budget was used for this workstream (to be implemented by UNICEF, IFRC/MHPSS Hub and IOM). That budget has now been submitted by UNICEF as background to this workstream (MINBUZA-2025.2698393). The contribution through UNICEF will be provided as a contribution to the UNICEF Mental Health Pooled Fund.
Copied from 230002651: The MHPSS Surge Mechanism is a programme that aims to increase understanding, coordination and better integration of MHPSS in emergency response. To achieve this the project rapidly deploys MHPSS experts at the request of cooperating humanitarian organisations in disaster, violence, conflict and/or refugee/migration-related crises.
With the September 2025 top-up during the remaining 16 months additional deployments can be realized, but also efforts will be intensified to also build capacity and effect deployments in conflict settings and protracted crises, with a focus on MHPSS and peacebuilding, across the H(D)P nexus.
